Package neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.twophasepipe.closure

Class BubbleSizeClosure

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.twophasepipe.closure.BubbleSizeClosure
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class BubbleSizeClosure extends Object implements Serializable
Configurable algebraic bubble-size closure for liquid-continuous bubbly-flow models.

The closure exposes the historical TwoFluidPipe buoyancy/capillary diameter scale as explicit configuration. By default it uses a fixed 0.02 N/m surface tension and a D/5 geometry cap, preserving the existing bubble and dispersed-bubble calculations. Callers may opt into the local phase-property surface tension already supplied by the pipe section.

This is a single algebraic characteristic size. It does not model a bubble-size distribution, deformation, coalescence, breakup, or turbulent-dissipation dependence.

      public void setUseLocalSurfaceTension(boolean useLocal)
      Selects the local phase-property surface tension supplied for each pipe section.

      The default is false, which preserves the historical fixed 0.02 N/m calculation. When enabled, the five-argument estimate validates and uses its local surface tension argument.

      Parameters:

    • estimateDiameter

      public double estimateDiameter(double pipeDiameter, double continuousPhaseDensity, double dispersedPhaseDensity, double gravity, double localSurfaceTension)
      Estimates a characteristic bubble diameter with optional local phase-property surface tension.

      The uncapped historical scale is 2 * sqrt(0.725 * sigma / (g * abs(deltaRho))). The returned value is capped at maximumPipeDiameterFraction * pipeDiameter. The localSurfaceTension argument is used only when isUseLocalSurfaceTension() is true.

      Parameters:
      pipeDiameter - internal pipe diameter in m
      continuousPhaseDensity - continuous-phase density in kg/m3
      dispersedPhaseDensity - dispersed-phase density in kg/m3
      gravity - gravitational acceleration magnitude in m/s2
      localSurfaceTension - local phase-property surface tension in N/m
      Returns:
      characteristic bubble diameter in m
